/* CustomsMapper.selectSendDelivery : 배송지변경신고 대상 조회 */ SELECT ad.DELIVERY_DOC_NO ,edi.EDI_JOB_NO ,edi.EDI_DOC_NO ,edi.EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID
,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS ISSUE_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()), 112) AS LIMIT_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ad.SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE, 112) AS SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ad.CLEARANCE_DATE, 112) AS CLEARANCE_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ad.DELIVERY_DATE, 112) AS DELIVERY_DATE ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,mod.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,mod.LINE_CODE ,mod.VOYAGE ,od.DELIVERY_NAME_CHANGED ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.HBL_NO ,od.DELIVERY_ADDRESS_CHANGED ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.CD_TYPE ,(SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') AS HOLD_CODE ,ad.DROP_YN ,od.DELIVERY_REASON_CHANGED ,od.MRN ,od.MSN ,od.HSN ,od.BOUND ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.DEST_PORT ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,bus.EDI_EXPRESS_SIGN FROM TB_EDI_LINKED edi INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON edi.EDI_DOC_NO = ad.DELIVERY_DOC_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND mod.BL_TYPE_MH ='M' INNER JOIN TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_ECM bus ON bus.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND bus.BOUND = od.BOUND AND bus.BOUND_TYPE = od.BOUND_TYPE AND bus.EDI_CITY_PORT = od.DEST_PORT WHERE ad.DELIVERY_DOC_NO = #{ediDocNo} AND edi.EDI_STATUS IN('EDI','ERROR')
mapper.update: /* CustomsMapper.updateDeliveryChangedSeqNo : 배송지변경신고순번 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET DELIVERY_CHANGED_SEQ_NO = #{deliveryChangedSeqNo} WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO}

/* CustomsMapper.selectSendUnmanagementHouse : 별도관리물품해제 대상 조회 */ SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), masterOd.AR_DATE, 112) AS AR_DATE ,masterOd.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,masterOd.DEST_PORT ,masterOd.MBL_NO ,masterOd.MRN ,masterOd.MSN ,masterOd.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,masterOd.BOUND ,masterOd.BOUND_TYPE ,masterOd.DEST_PORT ,od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.GWT ,od.PIECES ,od.CUSTOMS_CODE ,ad.SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO
,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS ISSUE_DATE ,edi.EDI_JOB_NO ,edi.EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID ,edi.EDI_DOC_NO ,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = masterOd.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CITY_PORT' AND CODE = masterOd.DEST_PORT) AS DEST_COUNTRY FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD masterOd ON masterOd.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND masterOd.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M' INNER JOIN TB_EDI_LINKED edi ON edi.EDI_DOC_NO = ad.SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND ad.SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO = #{ediDocNo} AND (edi.EDI_STATUS IS NULL OR edi.EDI_STATUS IN('', '2', '4'))

/* CustomsMapper.selectSendUnmanagementItem : 별도관리물품해제 대상 조회 */ SELECT item.MANAGE_TYPE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), item.AR_DATE, 112) AS AR_DATE ,item.FLIGHT_NO ,item.ITEM_DESC ,item.GWT ,item.DEST_PORT ,item.PIECES ,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CITY_PORT' AND CODE = item.DEST_PORT) AS DEST_COUNTRY FROM TB_ECM_OD_SPECIAL_ITEM item WHERE item.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* CustomsMapper.selectSendFulfillment : 수출이행신고 대상 조회 */ SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), od.OB_DATE, 112) AS OB_DATE ,REPLACE(od.OB_TIME, ':', '') AS OB_TIME ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.HBL_NO ,od.CONSIGNEE_COUNTRY_CODE ,od.BOUND ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.DEST_PORT ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO ,lic.EFN_PO_NO ,lic.EFN_SENDER_CODE ,lic.GWT ,lic.PIECES ,lic.LICENSE_NO ,lic.EFN_DELIVERY_NO ,lic.EFN_DOC_NO ,lic.EFN_TYPE ,lic.COMBINE_YN
,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'SIGN_AIRLINE' AND ETC2 = od.LINE_CODE) AS LINE_CODE
,(SELECT TOP 1 EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_ECM WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AND BOUND = od.BOUND AND EDI_CITY_PORT = od.ORIG_CODE ORDER BY SEQ_NO) AS EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID
,(SELECT TOP 1 EDI_EXPRESS_SIGN FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_CODE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AND BOUND = od.BOUND AND EDI_CITY_PORT = od.ORIG_CODE) AS EDI_EXPRESS_SIGN ,(SELECT TOP 1 POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM121''ECM127''ECM125') AS SEND_POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_LICENSE lic ON lic.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND lic.EFN_SENDER_CODE != ''
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND od.CD_TYPE = 'E' AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO != '' AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IS NOT NULL
AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') IN('', 'ERROR', 'RECV03')
AND ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS IN('RECV01', 'RECV02')

/* CustomsMapper.updateEdiStatus : 수출이행신고 송수신상태업데이트 */
UPDATE ad SET ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS = CONCAT('SEND', #{sendType}) ,ad.SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_TIME = CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()), 108) ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = CASE WHEN ISNULL(LAST_POD_STATUS, '') < 'ECM128' THEN #{podStatus} ELSE LAST_POD_STATUS END ,ad.LOAD_CMPL_YN = 'N' FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_LICENSE lic ON lic.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND lic.EFN_SENDER_CODE != ''
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND od.CD_TYPE = 'E' AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO != '' AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IS NOT NULL
AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') IN('', 'ERROR', 'RECV03')
AND ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS IN('RECV01', 'RECV02')
DELETE FROM cmpl FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_LOAD_CMPL cmpl ON cmpl.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND od.CD_TYPE = 'E' AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO != '' AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IS NOT NULL AND ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS = CONCAT('SEND', #{sendType})
UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET
SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS = 'ERROR'
SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS = CONCAT('SEND', #{sendType})
,SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,SIMPLE_DOC_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,SIMPLE_DOC_TIME = CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()), 108)
,LAST_POD_STATUS = CASE WHEN ISNULL(LAST_POD_STATUS, '') < 'ECM128' THEN #{podStatus} ELSE LAST_POD_STATUS END WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
mapper.select: /* CustomsMapper.selectSendAbnormalities : 하기결과이상보고 대상 조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.MRN) AS MRN ,MAX(od.MSN) AS MSN ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), MAX(od.AR_DATE), 112) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(od.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(od.DEST_CODE) AS DEST_CODE ,MAX(od.CUSTOMS_CODE) AS CUSTOMS_CODE ,MAX(od.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE) AS CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,MAX(abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE) AS ABNORMAL_CODE ,MAX(abnormal.MRN) AS MRN_ABNORMAL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), MAX(abnormal.AR_DATE), 112) AS AR_DATE_ABNORMAL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS ISSUE_DATE ,MAX(od.LINE_CODE) AS LINE_CODE ,MAX(od.VENDER_ID_1) AS EDI_VENDER FROM TB_ECM_OD houseOd INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = houseOd.OD_JOB_NO AND abnormal.SEND_DATE IS NULL INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON houseOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE houseOd.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo}) GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO

/* CustomsMapper.selectSendBmsInPlanAbnormalities : 하기결과이상보고 대상 조회(반입예정데이터) */ SELECT bip.MBL_NO ,SUBSTRING(MAX(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO), 1, 11) AS MRN ,SUBSTRING(MAX(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO), 12, 4) AS MSN ,REPLACE(MAX(bip.AR_DATE), '-', '') AS AR_DATE ,MAX(bip.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(bip.CUSTOMS_CODE) AS CUSTOMS_CODE ,MAX(bip.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE) AS CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,MAX(abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE) AS ABNORMAL_CODE ,MAX(abnormal.MRN) AS MRN_ABNORMAL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), MAX(abnormal.AR_DATE), 112) AS AR_DATE_ABNORMAL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS ISSUE_DATE ,'QQ' AS LINE_CODE ,'KTNET' AS EDI_VENDER FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO) AND abnormal.SEND_DATE IS NULL WHERE bip.IN_PLAN_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo}) GROUP BY bip.MBL_NO
